note: The RPC payload controls the attribute-array element count decoded from the wire.
The decoder records array size as count times CK_ATTRIBUTE size, which is only a structural estimate and not the true serialized byte size for nested attribute arrays.
The serializer/deserializer pair uses CK_ATTRIBUTE-sized accounting for attribute arrays, propagating the mistaken size model.
The malformed length model is emitted onto the RPC wire as the array count, driving downstream allocation and parsing decisions.
